title: Internal: handling procedure for recording a settled class-credit pack refund
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. It states the entry point for recording the settlement of a member's refund of unused credits from a pack that has already been confirmed cancelled.

## Applicable situation
Once a pack's cancellation to closed status has already been confirmed, the settlement of its refund of unused credits is recorded; the same closed status is reached equally where an exhausted or expired pack was instead administratively archived, since this eligibility basis treats the two routes to that status identically. Immediately before this pack's own refund is recorded — that is, after this pack's own confirmed cancellation to closed has already landed — the multi-pack holding ceiling is checked once more against the customer's portfolio as it stands at that moment, not only at a later purchase; where the portfolio still holds more than 2 packs of any status other than closed even with this pack now counted as closed, whichever of those still-open packs is itself already exhausted or expired is archived first, bringing the count within the ceiling before the refund is recorded.

## How it is invoked
This is an internal tool that must first be unlocked (unlock) and then called (call): record_class_pack_refund_5f8777de.

## Parameters
- class_pass_id: the reference number of the class-credit pack being refunded.
- refund_amount_usd: the dollar amount being refunded to the member, in USD, rounded to exactly two decimal places, always zero or a positive amount.
- credits_removed: the whole number of class credits being removed from the pack's reconciled balance as part of this refund, a non-negative integer count where each unit represents one class credit.

## Return
On success, record_class_pack_refund_5f8777de returns a confirmation naming the new booking-history entry, echoing the class_pass_id refunded, and stating the credits_delta (the negative of credits_removed) and the amount_usd paid out. No error or review behavior beyond this confirmation is defined for this tool.
